children: Cineplex has appointed Bill Walker to take over the lead role from retiring long-time chief executive Ellis Jacob, and said it is considering a sale as part of a newly launched strategic review.

Walker brings to the Canadian movie theater chain a wealth of experience in retail and entertainment. He was previously CEO of Landmark Cinemas, another Canadian theater chain which sold to Belgium-based Kinepolis Group in 2017.

He succeeds Jacob, who announced his retirement in June 2025. Jacob has been the head of Cineplex chain since 2003, and will remain on board serving as a special adviser to the board until the end of the year.
At the same time, the company has announced that it has launched a strategic review to evaluate new opportunities to maximize value for its shareholders.
Cineplex said it will consider a range of alternatives, which could include a potential sale, among others. Jacob is expected to work with the board on the review.
